messages:
maria (docs): Heads up — the Console quickstart playground preview is failing for new signups, getting an empty iframe + console 500s when you press Run.
kevin (console): ack, thanks for the ping. repro steps?
maria (docs): Open Playground -> choose any model -> Run -> Network shows POST /telemetry/events returning 500 and preview never renders. error: "missing telemetry key" in gateway logs.
jenna (qa): saw this yesterday. telemetry key rotated in infra; docs sample still uses hardcoded TELEMETRY_KEY. quick fix replaces with process.env variable.
sam (devex): can we get a docs PR with a smoke test? I can help wire CI to run the iframe preview headlessly.
maria (docs): creating PR now and adding the test. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3842 (will update after commits).
kevin (console): also note: private deploys need gateway proxy config, so add a small note in console/preview.md about requiring the telemetry header X-Redwood-Telemetry.
jenna (qa): add label `pr:run-preview` so deploy-bot picks it up. Also adding a quick unit test: examples/playground/test_preview.py to assert 200 on /preview-session.
maria (docs): updated snippet in PR — replaced hardcoded key and added fallback:
```js
const telemetryKey = process.env.REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_KEY || '';
await fetch('/telemetry/events', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'x-redwood-telemetry': telemetryKey },
  body: JSON.stringify({ event: 'playground_run' })
});
```
sam (devex): tiny nit: gateway expects header name `x-redwood-telemetry` (thanks jenna). I pushed a commit to the branch to match that.
kevin (console): thanks — can you also tweak the Playground Quickstart note to clarify that the preview uses the public proxy and won't work on air-gapped private deployments unless they configure the proxy.
maria (docs): done in last commit + added section "Troubleshooting preview failures" with the logs snippet and steps.
jenna (qa): running the headless smoke locally: `pytest examples/playground/test_preview.py::test_preview_headless` — passes on my machine. Adding to CI matrix. :white_check_mark:
sam (devex): nice. can we also add a small Python SDK example showing how to post telemetry from server-side? keep it 3 lines.
maria (docs): added python snippet under examples/server/telemetry.py:
```py
import os
import requests
key = os.getenv('REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_KEY', '')
requests.post('https://proxy.redwood.ai/telemetry/events', headers={'x-redwood-telemetry': key}, json={'event':'run'})
```
kevin (console): LGTM. @deploy-bot please run preview infra and smoke tests.
deploy-bot: running preview infra smoke job for PR 3842... logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/3842/preview-log (job queued)
jenna (qa): when CI passes can someone merge and backport to the v1.2 docs branch? we had a lot of signups hitting this.
maria (docs): will merge after CI green and open a small backport PR. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :rocket:
